title: VeloraOS 1.10.56 - Core Models & Mobile Response Polish
releaseNotes: Restores the animated three-dot activity indicator in standalone mobile Chat while VeloraOS is thinking and responding.
Makes VeloraOS Main (Qwen2.5 3B), VeloraOS Vision (LLaVA 7B) and VeloraOS Coding (Qwen2.5 Coder 7B) the three supported core models.
Keeps image attachments routed to VeloraOS Vision and Coding mode routed to VeloraOS Coding for a predictable supported experience.
Moves every other installed Ollama model into a collapsed Advanced Custom Models area instead of mixing it into the normal model catalogue.
Allows validated Ollama-compatible custom model downloads, deliberate custom Chat selection, administrator deletion and one-tap restoration of VeloraOS Main.
Keeps custom models out of automatic image and coding routing and bumps the PWA application shell to 1.10.56.
